result.topic_en: Scratch calculations on second-order linear ODEs of the type d²u/dx² + c x u = 0 (Airy/Bessel type), with trial solutions of the form cos/sin(α x^{3/2}) with variable amplitude, a related integral representation, and Riccati equations such as v² + dv/dx = 2x.

methods.what: Airy-type ODE u'' + q²u = 0 / u'' + x u considered
Double integral representation via substitution y+z=s, yz=p
Trial asymptotic solution with phase α x^{3/2} and variable amplitude
Amplitude-phase (ψ sin φ) differentiation and relation between amplitude and phase
Riccati equation and substitution v = 1/x + w
Riccati equation v² + v' = 2x treated by inverting to x as function of v
